# Inter font notice

The Latin variable subset at `src/app/fonts/inter-latin-var.woff2` was inherited from
Warpdrive and is unchanged by this localization work. Its SHA-256 is `c940764593d0fe5d596be327ca7558855e018039fb78509aa21921fd3644c3e4`.

Inter is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The copyright and license
text here was retrieved on 2026-10-29 from the [official Google Fonts Inter
license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/inter/OFL.txt). The font has its own license; the CRM's MIT license does not replace it.

The app also serves this notice at `/licenses/Inter-OFL.txt`. `public/licenses/`
is copied into the runtime image so the notice accompanies the distributed font.
The corresponding Vazirmatn copyright/license and author notices are served there too.
